children: A slew of geopolitical challenges and increased competition have weighed on Shein's revenue growth and valuation, Morningstar analyst Lorraine Tan says in a research note. Morningstar "would not be surprised if Shein's revenue growth hovers around the current 7.5% pace over the next three years, especially after the change in de minimis policies and tariffs have raised the average cost of items sold in the U.S., which is a key market." Tan notes that Shein's low operating margin is an even bigger hurdle as it reflects the lower selling price and overall purchase value of Shein's products. Still, the analyst thinks Shein is well positioned to weather its current hiccups given its net cash position. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
